case: LONGHORN-48 independent single-node DR target prerequisites
classification: test-gate/environment fixture; existing product core entry, no product or image changes
product_entry: kubecli new longhorn-v2-dr-target; config.yml/hosts; kubecli download -D; kubecli setup longhorn-v2-dr-target 90
smallest_disproof: corresponding focused fixed command after static contracts; core is blocked until target transport qualification
conclusions: DR requires two independent clusters and the same external backup target; current three-node source is retained and cannot serve as its own target.

Official Standby is an asynchronous backup restore consumer; target core qualification proves only separate UID/context and same-node DNS/HTTP functionality. Standby, fencing, activation and controlled failback remain separate pending assertions.
A one-node target uses one replica in the later storage profile and cannot qualify target-site node HA.

Reuse the published exact pinned infrastructure images and product core workflow. Own only .149, its stable allowlisted blank disk and independent cluster directory/network; this core stage never prepares hugepages or raw disk.

Bootstrap appends only public keys over preexisting authenticated user/sudo access under the runner lease, binds the approved machine/disk and installs the authenticated host key on the control host. No password transfer or host-key bypass.
Preserve source cluster/namespace/node/raw disk identity and config digest before/after. Stop on unknown target state; core failure cleanup is machine-bound and source nodes are excluded.
artifact_dependencies: Existing published Longhorn artifact set and Kubernetes 1.33.6/core artifacts; no new Dockerfile, tag, workflow or registry publication
cross_repo_impact: kubeauto test fixture/runner only; five sibling repositories unchanged
cleanup_scope: Target-only relay/rule/socket/probes; preserve healthy target core on success; failure may clean only its owned core and restore original hostname. Preserve root public key bootstrap as lab access infrastructure. Source and developer host never wiped.
scope: No Longhorn/DR business PASS, final module acceptance or target-site HA claim
